name: world-pulse
description: Native Android/iOS wrapper for the World Pulse web app (Capacitor). The site and API themselves need only Python.

scripts.cap:android: cap add android && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#14110f' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#14110f' --splashBackgroundColor '#14110f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#14110f' && cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: cap add ios && capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#14110f' --splashBackgroundColor '#14110f' && cap sync ios
